answer: AI agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via collateralized identity. Each agent must stake significant native currency, creating a financial barrier. The cost to acquire enough tokens for a large-scale attack must reach its economic zenith. This system serves as an economic atlas, delineating legitimate actors. An attacker seeking to flood the network would need to expend capital akin to controlling every digital resource in a vast meadow, making widespread identity fabrication economically prohibitive due to the immense outlay required per fake agent.
